text:
Lina: quick callout — onboarding reranker-xsmall-int4 on staging: ndcg@10 drops ~2.1% on webqa-alt dataset but mrr@10 nearly identical. dump below.
Omar: webqa-alt is the weird one with mixed html/snippets, right? Could be tokenization edgecases.
Lina: yes. baseline fp32 ndcg@10=0.582, int4=0.571. mrr@10 baseline 0.424 -> int4 0.422.
Priya: small NDCG hits with quant often come from score noise near decision boundary. Do we have top1 swap table?
Lina: pasted small excerpt of diffs:
```
query: "how to reset wifi"
baseline top1 doc=doc_993 score=2.13
int4 top1 doc=doc_1011 score=2.05
```
Omar: scores are close. Also check whether candidate normalization was applied consistently — I recall a change to `score_norm=true` in the shadow harness last week.
Lina: I used harness v2.3 which sets `score_norm=false` by default for raw inspection. But production comparisons used normalize=true historically.
Priya: ah that mismatch could amplify perceived ndcg delta. Re-run with normalize=true for fair parity.
ci-bot: "run: 3880012345-rb; artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/3880"
Lina: re-ran with normalize=true: baseline 0.580 -> int4 0.576 (delta -0.7%). Better but still present, especially on short-head queries.
Omar: ok. Next hypothesis: tokenization / truncation differences in candidate pipeline. We switched proto serializer to `truncate_chars=2048` for speed; reranker expects token-truncate.
Priya: that mismatch has bitten us before. For short queries, title vs first-paragraph signals matter and char-truncate can chop tokens unpredictably.
Lina: I diffed a few docs — proto truncation cut mid-token sometimes for unicode heavy docs. Example: doc_1011 got its snippet chopped at an emoji boundary, altering token offsets.
Omar: that can shift attention patterns enough to re-rank. Quick fix: change serializer to token-aware truncation. But still, quant noise exists.
Priya: also run an ablation: int4 + float32 last-layer-rescale. If the final linear stays fp32, often reduces top1 flips.
Lina: started three runs (all normalize=true): 1) int4 default -> ndcg 0.576 2) int4 + fp32-final -> ndcg 0.579 3) int4 + token-truncation serializer -> ndcg 0.582
Omar: nice — serializer fix recovers almost everything. Looks like composition: truncation mismatch + quant jitter caused the bulk.
Priya: action items: (Lina) merge serializer token-truncate PR and add unit test for unicode/emoji boundaries; (Omar) add int4 quick-ablation that toggles fp32-final to our quant CI; (Priya) update eval docs to require normalize flag parity for production comparisons.
Lina: created PR #742 for serializer change. Also added a small sanity check in rankbench: `--compare-tokens` which asserts tokenization parity between candidate binary and reranker.
deploy-bot: "note: serializer token-truncate PR opened by Lina (#742) at 2026-03-21T09:15Z"
ci-bot: "note: quant-ablation job queued (priority: high)"
Omar: let's also add a per-query report to surface queries with top1 doc swapped and score delta < 0.1 to triage brittle cases.
Priya: good idea. We'll keep a watch on webqa-alt for a week after rollout. Lina pls post final canary numbers after PR merge. :eyes:
